item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-59346 - VMware
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.3
Resumo:
VMware Workstation and Fusion contain an integer-overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor with local administrative privileges on a virtual machine with VMXNET3 virtual network adapter may exploit this issue to execute code on the host. Affected versions: - VMware Workstation: 25H2, 26H1 (fixed in 26H1u1) - VMware Fusion: 25H2, 26H1 (fixed in 26H1u1)
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-59346

Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.4
Resumo:
LearnPress plugin for WordPress through 4.4.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated instructors to inject scripts via quiz question hint and explanation fields.
